statements.impact_statement: CMS_encrypt and CMS_encrypt_ex can loop forever with an EC recipient certificate whose group order is 1. Drydock performs no CMS encryption, so the code is never executed. Only Alpine openssl, libssl3 and libcrypto3 3.5.9-r0 are covered; no other revision is. Remove this document (and its vex-documents entry) when Alpine ships a fixed openssl.

AES-GCM-SIV resets the AAD on a zero-length AAD update. GCM-SIV is not a TLS cipher suite and Drydock never calls it, so the code is never executed. Only Alpine openssl, libssl3 and libcrypto3 3.5.9-r0 are covered; no other revision is. Remove this document (and its vex-documents entry) when Alpine ships a fixed openssl.

AES-GCM-SIV with a short IV can over-read the heap. GCM-SIV is not a TLS cipher suite and Drydock never calls it, so the code is never executed. Only Alpine openssl, libssl3 and libcrypto3 3.5.9-r0 are covered; no other revision is. Remove this document (and its vex-documents entry) when Alpine ships a fixed openssl.

The OpenSSL QUIC client can hit a use-after-free against a malicious QUIC server. Drydock's outbound traffic is HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 over TCP TLS. The system libssl3 and libcrypto3 consumers in the image are apk-tools, libcurl (git over HTTPS, which does not use HTTP/3) and busybox ssl_client, and Node bundles its own OpenSSL instead of linking the system library, so the QUIC client is never executed. Only Alpine openssl, libssl3 and libcrypto3 3.5.9-r0 are covered; no other revision is. Remove this document (and its vex-documents entry) when Alpine ships a fixed openssl.
